item.title: NYSC kidnap saga: Two witnesses testify in court
item.description: By Chidi Nkwopara The Department of State Services, DSS, on Friday, called two witnesses in the ongoing suit, HOU/22C/2026, filed against Usman Aliyu, Mohamed Aliyu and Babangida Ali, over the October 1, 2026, kidnap of 20 prospective members of the National Youths Service Corps, NYSC, who were travelling to their orientation camps in Abia and Akwa Ibom states. Led in evidence by the Principal State Counsel, Mr. Ekezie Nwauzor, the second prosecution witness, PW2, a commercial motorcyclist, Mr. Light Timothy, gave a graphic account of how the first and second accused persons hired him to take them to where their colleagues were staying. According to PW2, his two passengers were carrying a bag, which he never knew the content until they reached their lonely destination, where AK-47 rifles were brought out from it. He recalled that when his passenger put a call to someone, his intonation sounded Hausa or Fulani and the fellow urged him to ply the Umuguma-Okuku Road in Owerri West Local Government Area of Imo State. PW2 also told the court that at a point, fear gripped him and he wanted to go back but not long after, four men jumped out of the bush, collected the bag, opened it and brought out the AK-47 rifles. Timothy also told the court that he would have been killed for wasting time on the road, if not that one of them pleaded on his behalf and he sped off from that point. In his own evidence, the third prosecution witness, PW3, and Akwa Ibom Transport Company driver, Mr. Sunday Udoh, confirmed that he and another driver, Jeremiah, were carrying NYSC members from Ibadan, to their orientation camps. They had a stopover at Onitsha and left 5.30am on October 1, 2026, adding that heading towards Owerri and not long after passing a checkpoint, he noticed two stationary mini buses. He told the court that on sensing looming danger and he quickly tried to reverse but his vehicle hit something behind and they were stuck. According to Udoh, he switched off his vehicle, ran to the other side of the highway, hid in the nearby bush and watched events from there. Udoh, after identifying Usman Aliyu as one of the attackers, also said that the kidnappers took away five of his passengers and 15 from Jeremiah’s bus, into the bush. After thorough cross-examination of the two witnesses by the defence counsel, Paschal Ofoma, Justice Emeka Orafu adjourned the matter for further hearing to November 3, 2026. The post NYSC kidnap saga: Two witnesses testify in court appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Roma eyeing Kevin Santos, Nusa and Kvernadze for January
item.description: Roma eyeing Kevin Santos, Nusa and Kvernadze for January Roma is working to strengthen its attack ahead of the winter transfer window. According to Calciomercato.it , the Giallorossi management has identified three players to strengthen Gian Piero Gasperini’s wingers. Sporting director D’Amico has reportedly already initiated contact with Kevin Santos Lopes de Macedo, Antonio Nusa, and Giorgi Kvernadze. The former, born in 2003, is a left winger currently owned by Fulham. Nusa, meanwhile, plays for Leipzig and was also approached in the last transfer window, while Kvernadze, a 23-year-old Georgian, is making his mark in Serie A with Frosinone. The winger is therefore Roma’s priority heading into January. Three names are on the table, with the management working to identify the right player to hand over to Gasperini ahead of the second half of the season.

item.title: ‘He really changed my life’-Travis Hunter stands by Deion Sanders amid Colorado turmoil
item.description: Photo by Ric Tapia/Getty Images Travis Hunter has delivered a heartfelt message of support for Deion Sanders amid growing questions about the Colorado Buffaloes head coach’s future following a difficult season. The former Colorado star reflected on his recruitment and explained how Sanders changed his outlook on football during an appearance on Ja’Marr Chase’s podcast, Chasing No. 1 . Colorado have endured a challenging campaign, sitting at 2-5 overall after losing five consecutive games and going 0-4 in Big 12 conference play. Travis Hunter explains how Deion Sanders changed his life Hunter revealed that he had initially planned to join Florida State before Sanders intervened and convinced him to choose Colorado. “I was 100% going to Florida State,” Hunter said . Sanders then spoke with Hunter and his family about his vision for the young star, particularly his ambition to play on both sides of the ball. Having played both offence and defence himself, the Pro Football Hall of Famer promised Hunter an opportunity, provided he earned it. “You want to play both sides of the ball? I’m definitely the coach that’s going to—you know, I’ve done it before—but you’re going to have to earn it,” Sanders said, according to Hunter. The Jacksonville Jaguars star made it clear that his respect for Sanders goes far beyond what happened on the football field. “I got too much respect for him,” Hunter added. “He came and got me to not go to Florida State and changed my mindset, changed the picture of everything. He really changed my life for real.” Hunter’s comments come at a difficult time for Sanders, whose Colorado tenure has come under increasing scrutiny following the team’s recent struggles. The Buffaloes finished 3-9 last season and appear to be facing another disappointing campaign. If their current form continues, they could miss out on bowl eligibility for the third time in Sanders’ four seasons as head coach. ESPN’s Matt Barrie has even described Sanders’ Colorado tenure as “as good as done”, although there has been no indication that university officials are ready to part ways with him. For now, Hunter’s comments offer a reminder of the impact Sanders had on one of college football’s biggest stars. Whether the Buffaloes can turn their season around will be crucial as questions about the coach’s future continue. item.title: Enugu APC releases updated campaign council list
item.description: The Enugu State chapter of the All Progressives Congress (APC) has released an updated list of its Campaign Council. In a press release on Friday, the State Chairman of the party, Dr. Martin Chukwunweike, and the State Secretary, Hon. Chukwudi Nnadozie, said the update had become imperative as more critical stakeholders across the state expressed their readiness to be part of the team to deliver President Bola Tinubu, Governor Peter Mbah and all APC candidates in the 2027 general elections. “So, we are happy to welcome them on board as the party grows from strength to strength for a landslide victory come 2027,” the statement read. Meanwhile, a perusal through the list showed that nothing changed with the leadership of the Campaign Council. There were mainly additions to the membership cadre and minor housekeeping. The Campaign Council, comprising 51 Directorates, is still chaired by the Governor of the state, Dr. Peter Mbah, while the Deputy Governor, Barr. Ifeanyi Ossai; Deputy National Chairman, APC (South); Speaker, Enugu State House of Assembly, Rt. Hon. Uchenna Ugwu; Chairman of the party in the state, Dr. Martin Chukwunweike; and the Secretary to the State Government, Prof. Chidiebere Onyia, are Vice Chairmen. The Council is also headlined by an Advisory Council comprising former President of the Senate, Ken Nnamani; former governor of old Anambra State, Senator Jim Nwobodo; former military governor of old Anambra State and Chief of the Naval Staff, Rear Admiral Allison Madueke (Rtd.); former Minister of Power, Prof. Barth Nnaji; former Minister of Information and governorship candidate of the All Progressives Grand Alliance (APGA) in the 2023 governorship election in the state, Mr. Frank Nweke Jr.; business mogul, Prince Arthur Eze; Senator Chuka Utazi; and former deputy governors Mrs. Cecilia Ezeilo, Bishop Ralph Nwoye, Dr. Sunday Onyebuchi, and Chief Okechukwu Itanyi, among other high-profile personalities. Chief Charlie Mbah is the Director-General, while Dr. Eric Oluedo served as the Secretary-General. Senator Osita Ngwu, Senator Ikeje Asogwa, and Senator Kelvin Chukwu are Coordinators of the Campaign Council in Enugu West, Enugu North, and Enugu East, respectively. Deacon Okey Ogbodo, Dr. Dan Shere, and Hon. S.K.E. Udeh-Okoye are Deputy Campaign DGs for Enugu East Senatorial District, Enugu North Senatorial District, and Enugu West Senatorial District, respectively. Barr. Steve Oruruo is the Campaign Spokesperson and Director of the Public Communication Committee, with Dr. Austin Okolie as co-spokesperson and Dr. Malachy Agbo as Secretary. Mazi Uche Anichukwu and Dan Nwomeh, both drawn from the Governor’s media team, head the Directorate of New Media and Strategic Communication and the Directorate of Mainstream Media, respectively. item.title: 2. Bundesliga preview: FC St. Pauli vs. 1. FC Nürnberg
item.description: 2. Bundesliga preview: FC St. Pauli vs. 1. FC Nürnberg FC St. Pauli will be looking to return to winning ways when they welcome promotion hopefuls 1. FC Nürnberg in an important 2. Bundesliga encounter on Sunday. Marcel Rapp’s side currently occupy seventh place with 12 points from their opening nine matches, while Miroslav Klose’s Nürnberg are second with 18 points, seven behind league leaders Hertha BSC. St. Pauli have developed a reputation for being difficult to beat in recent weeks, but a run of consecutive draws has prevented them from climbing further up the standings. Meanwhile, Nürnberg have enjoyed an impressive start to the campaign, although their recent league form has begun to show signs of inconsistency. With both sides targeting promotion, Sunday’s meeting at the Millerntor promises to be an important test of their respective ambitions. FC St. Pauli St. Pauli head into Sunday’s encounter unbeaten in their last six league matches, although their recent inability to turn draws into victories has prevented them from building greater momentum. Rapp’s side have recorded two victories and six draws from their opening nine fixtures, with their only league defeat coming earlier in the campaign. Their most recent outing ended in a goalless draw away to SV Darmstadt 98, extending their run of consecutive league draws to two following a 1-1 result against Hannover 96. Despite the lack of victories, St. Pauli have demonstrated considerable defensive improvement, conceding just nine goals in nine league matches. Their attacking output has been less consistent, however, with the Hamburg outfit scoring 11 goals during that period. Abdoulie Ceesay has been one of their most important attacking players, scoring four league goals in seven appearances. The forward will once again be expected to play a significant role against Nürnberg. Rapp will also be encouraged by his team’s performances at the Millerntor, where they have collected seven points from their opening four home league fixtures. Speaking ahead of Sunday’s encounter, the St. Pauli coach expressed confidence in his team’s preparations and acknowledged the quality of their opponents. “We are well prepared and looking forward to a good game against a very good opponent. We are confident and excited about the weekend,” Rapp explained. The coach also praised Nürnberg’s attacking quality and ability to press opponents aggressively, warning that his players would need to perform at their highest level. “We’ll have to give our all and dig deep at times. We’re going out to win and then we'll see whether it turns out to be a top game or not.” he added. St. Pauli will therefore be targeting a third league victory of the campaign as they look to close the gap on the promotion places. 1. FC Nürnberg Nürnberg travel to Hamburg looking to strengthen their position in the promotion race, having collected 18 points from their opening nine league matches. item.title: Philip Rivers emerges as ‘focus’ of NC State’s coaching search
item.description: Kevin Ng-Imagn Images Philip Rivers emerges as ‘focus’ of NC State’s coaching search appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Since Dave Doeren’s firing from NC State football , Philip Rivers ’ name has surfaced more frequently than anyone else’s as a potential replacement for the program’s all-time winningest head coach. Now, the Wolfpack are reportedly narrowing their focus on the former NFL quarterback as they look to find their next leader following Doeren’s departure. According to a report from On3, Rivers has emerged as the primary target in NC State’s coaching search. “NC State legend and former NFL QB Philip Rivers has emerged as the focus of the Wolfpack’s coaching search. With Rivers finishing out the high school season in Alabama, sources tell On3 there is no timetable for his hiring,” the report read. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) NC State decided to part ways with Doeren following a disappointing start to the 2026 season. Doeren spent 14 seasons leading the Wolfpack before they dismissed him following a loss to Stanford. While conversations about a possible return to NC State continue to gain momentum, Rivers remains focused on his current responsibilities as the head coach of St. Michael Catholic High School in Alabama. He has been leading the program since 2021 and is now in his sixth season with the team. Meanwhile, after his team’s regular-season finale against Foley, Rivers provided a more direct response to the growing speculation about a potential return to his alma mater. “There is nothing there at this point,” Rivers said. “You understand the chatter that is out there. You take it one day at a time. I’m excited about this postseason with these guys. Like I said last year, you never say never, but there is nothing imminent.” Rivers has a deep-rooted connection with the Wolfpack, having played for the program from 2000 to 2003. Throughout his college career, he established himself as one of the most accomplished quarterbacks in NC State history. Now, a return to Raleigh could mark a new chapter in his football career. However, Rivers’ latest comments suggest that no immediate decision is expected. Whether the former NFL star eventually makes the move from high school coaching to leading his alma mater remains to be seen. item.title: 2. Bundesliga preview: Hannover 96 vs. Dynamo Dresden
item.description: 2. Bundesliga preview: Hannover 96 vs. Dynamo Dresden Hannover 96 will be desperate to end their difficult run of form when they welcome Dynamo Dresden in an important battle at the bottom of the 2. Bundesliga table on Sunday. Both sides have collected just eight points from their opening nine league matches, leaving Hannover in 16th place and Dresden immediately ahead of them in 15th. With both clubs already looking over their shoulders, Sunday’s encounter represents an important opportunity to gain some breathing space. Sandro Wagner’s Hannover are still searching for their first victory under their new head coach, while Thomas Stamm’s Dresden arrive with renewed confidence following their impressive DFB-Pokal victory over Schalke. Hannover 96 Hannover head into Sunday’s encounter under increasing pressure after another disappointing week, with Wagner still waiting for his first victory since taking charge in September. The former Germany international replaced Christian Titz in September but has so far struggled to turn Hannover’s performances into positive results. Their most recent league outing ended in a 2-0 defeat against local rivals Eintracht Braunschweig, a result that increased the pressure surrounding the club. Hannover subsequently suffered another setback on Wednesday evening, losing 2-0 at home to Kaiserslautern in the second round of the DFB-Pokal. Despite the result, there were encouraging aspects to their performance, with the hosts registering 22 attempts on goal and creating considerably more opportunities than their opponents. However, a lack of clinical finishing ultimately proved costly. Hannover have scored just eight goals in nine league matches this season, highlighting their difficulties in the final third. Defensively, they have also struggled, conceding 15 goals during that period. Nevertheless, there are reasons for optimism heading into Sunday’s fixture. Hannover have collected five of their eight league points at home and remain unbeaten across their last three league matches at the Heinz von Heiden Arena. Wagner will therefore be hoping his players can use home advantage to finally deliver the result their performances have occasionally deserved. With both teams sitting on eight points, the Hannover coach will understand the importance of securing victory against a direct relegation rival. Dynamo Dresden Dynamo travel to Lower Saxony looking to carry the confidence generated by their impressive DFB-Pokal victory over Schalke into their league campaign. Stamm’s side secured a 2-0 victory against the Bundesliga outfit on Wednesday evening, with Patrice Čović opening the scoring before Christoph Daferner sealed their progression into the last 16 with a late second goal. The result was particularly significant for a Dresden team that had struggled to find consistency throughout the opening weeks of the season. item.title: 2. Bundesliga preview: Greuther Fürth vs. Holstein Kiel
item.description: 2. Bundesliga preview: Greuther Fürth vs. Holstein Kiel Greuther Fürth will be looking to respond to last weekend’s disappointing defeat when they welcome Holstein Kiel in an important meeting between two sides separated by just one point in the 2. Bundesliga table. Heiko Vogel’s team currently occupy 12th place with nine points from their opening nine matches, while Holstein Kiel sit 13th with eight points. Both sides have endured inconsistent starts to the campaign, although the visitors arrive with considerably more confidence following consecutive victories in the league and DFB-Pokal. Fürth will be particularly keen to take advantage of home support, with Sunday’s encounter presenting an opportunity to move further away from the relegation places. Meanwhile, Tim Walter’s Kiel side will be targeting their first away league victory of the season as they look to build on an encouraging week. Greuther Fürth Greuther Fürth head into Sunday’s encounter looking to put an emphatic 3-0 defeat against VfL Osnabrück behind them. The result represented a significant setback for Vogel’s side, who struggled with individual errors and defensive organisation throughout the contest. Fürth have collected just nine points from their opening nine league matches, recording two victories, three draws and four defeats. Their attacking output has nevertheless offered some encouragement, with captain Felix Klaus proving particularly influential. The experienced winger has scored seven of the team’s 12 league goals and provided two assists, making him one of the most important players in Vogel’s squad. However, defensive inconsistency remains a concern, with the Kleeblatt having conceded 16 goals already this season. Vogel admitted that his team had experienced a collective collapse against Osnabrück, describing the performance as a ‘system failure’ and accepting responsibility for the disappointing result. Speaking ahead of Sunday’s encounter, the Fürth coach insisted that supporters would see a different performance from his players. “I believe we will see a completely different side to my team at the weekend,” Vogel explained. The coach also confirmed that he had given every player an opportunity to demonstrate their qualities during the training week, rather than singling individuals out following the defeat. Vogel will be particularly wary of the threat posed by Kiel, although he expects his team to remain committed to their own playing philosophy. Sunday’s encounter also presents Fürth with an opportunity to achieve a significant milestone, as victory would represent the club’s 500th win in the 2. Bundesliga. Holstein Kiel Holstein Kiel travel to Bavaria with renewed confidence after recording two consecutive victories across league and cup competitions. item.title: Clemens keeps playoff hopes alive in wild win over Pieper
item.description: Clemens' Eli Williams runs on the field at Rutledge Stadium in Converse, Texas on Friday, Sept. 18, 2026. (Katina Zentz/San Antonio Express-News) Clemens won its fourth District 28-6A game in a row and kept its playoff hopes alive by winning a 52-49 shootout over Pieper on Friday at Warrior Stadium. Devin Morgan scored the game winning touchdown for Clemens on a 1-yard run with just over two minutes remaining and the Buffaloes came up with two defensive stops in the final minute and a half, including an interception by Zarion Jordan. With the win, Clemens (7-2 overall, 4-2 District 28-6A) moved into a three-way tie for second with Pieper (5-4, 4-2) and Judson (4-4, 4-2) with one week left in the regular season. For Clemens to make its first playoff appearance in seven years, it needs to beat their rival Steele (6-1-1, 5-0), which has already clinched the district championship, Thursday at 7 p.m. at Lehnhoff Stadium. If the Buffaloes lose, they will need some outside help. Pieper finishes the regular season against Wagner (2-6, 1-5) next Friday at Rutledge Stadium and could clinch a playoff berth with a win. The Clemens winning streak started after losing their first two district games to Judson (51-41) and East Central (47-20). After his team's thrilling win over Pieper, Clemens coach Alan Hill wasn't focused on the scenarios for the Buffaloes making the playoffs. Hill was taking in the moment after getting a Gatorade bath from his team after the win. "It was huge," Hill said. "It has been a while. We clinched the first winning season last week (against Wagner) since 2019. That was huge. Obviously, we lost the wrong games early in district play so we still got some work to do or help (to get into playoffs) and we know that. It was a huge win, not just for our program and community, but just how hard our kids have been working, fighting and staying together. "I mean it says a lot about the character of the kids to climb out of an 0-2 hole in district play and reel off four in a row and not quit on their teammates and just go back to work and fight," Hill added. Clemens was led by sophomore running back Daniel Gray, who bullied his way through the Pieper defense for 90 yards rushing and three touchdowns, and by quarterback Carter Menchke, who threw two scoring passes. "We needed this one," Gray said. "Our playoff chances have gone up like a rocket." Gray said has confidence in his squad as they take on Steele next. "It's not impossible," Gray said. "I know some guys over there, they look pretty good but it's not impossible. We just proved that we can go toe-to-toe with any team including even if they are ranked higher than us." The Buffaloes were able to overcome the performance of Pieper quarterback Lance Reid, who went 21-of-31 for 246 yards and four touchdowns, and Pieper receiver Cade Diamond, who finished with 98 yards receiving and three scoring receptions. He practiced in full all week, so things look good for him, as they have all season. But can you even trust him? item.title: 'Chasing big totals is good for cricket': Sanath Jayasuriya
item.description: MUMBAI: Sri Lankan batting great Sanath Jayasuriya has given a thumbs-up to the recent trend of teams chasing down big totals on flat pitches in white-ball cricket. Sri Lanka pulled off the second-highest successful chase in ODIs when they overhauled England's 429-run total in a Tri-Series match in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, on October 22. "It's very good to see that it's happening and players are getting runs on the board and chasing it, which is good for cricket. Teams and players are getting more and more confident, and that is the key. Anything is possible these days, and it is good to see that teams are putting runs on the board and even chasing, but I can see that is also putting the bowlers under pressure," Jayasuriya told reporters at an event on Friday. "It's been a lot of changes in the rules. New things have come up in cricket with new regulations, which are good for the game," he added. Asked about the supremely talented and explosive Abhishek Sharma, who smashed a 38-ball 113, including a 35-ball century, to help India win the third T20I at Wellington by six wickets, Jayasuriya said, "He has a long way to go, but it is a good future for India. Let him play his natural game and let him do his work, and it will be a good investment for Indian cricket." "He (Abhishek) is an all-round player. You cannot say anything in specific is strong — he is an all-round player. He can play in any part of the park, so that is a good thing," he added. Praising India's white-ball team, Jayasuriya said, "They are talented cricketers and are playing well. India has got the talent and is playing good cricket at the moment. There are quite a few Indian players who have been doing well. Good to see them. They are talented, work hard and are playing well." Asked about Sri Lanka's impressive performance in Pakistan in the Tri-Series — they won two of their four matches and qualified for the final, where they will face Pakistan on Saturday — Jayasuriya felt that the campaign would boost their confidence ahead of their white-ball tour of India in December. "It's a good confidence (booster) for the Sri Lankan team, which is doing well before they come to India. The confidence is high, they are playing well, and I hope they will do well in India too," the former dashing left-hander, who also served as Sri Lanka's chief selector, said. Jayasuriya backed India to do well in the forthcoming ODI and Test series in New Zealand. "They are going to do well for sure, but away from India they have always looked to do well, and it will be a good series," he said.

item.title: Messiah Hampton Arrest: Why Was Oregon WR Arrested Ahead of Northwestern Matchup?
item.description: Dan Lanning Oregon © Reuters The Oregon Ducks will be without wide receiver Messiah Hampton for Saturday’s game against the Northwestern Wildcats. The Springfield Police Department arrested the freshman on charges of reckless driving and eluding police, according to The Oregonian’s Ryan Clarke. The report added that he was booked into Lane County Jail. The charges reportedly stem from his involvement in a high-speed chase on Oct. 18. Police reportedly pursued two vehicles but abandoned the chase for safety reasons. Springfield Deputy Chief George Crolly later said Hampton was one of the drivers in the incident. Hampton was listed as out on Oregon’s availability report for Saturday’s game, meaning the Ducks will have to rely on other options on the WR depth chart. Evan Stewart and Jalen Lott were not listed on Friday’s availability report and could return after missing last week’s loss to Illinois. Stewart began his collegiate career with Texas A&M in 2022. He transferred to Oregon in 2024. He missed the entire 2025 campaign after suffering a torn right patellar tendon. He has put up 352 yards on 27 receptions and four TDs in five games this season. Meanwhile, Lott committed to Dan Lanning’s team as part of the 2026 recruiting class. He’s seen limited time on the field, recording 29 receiving yards in two games. Dan Lanning shares his thoughts on Oregon’s struggles this season The Oregon Ducks started the year strong, posting a 3-1 record before their bye week. However, they lost two of their next three games, falling to UCLA and Illinois and only securing a win over Nebraska. Speaking with ‘105.1 The Fan,’ Lanning shared his thoughts on Oregon’s performances. “I’ve been part of games as an assistant where it didn’t always go well. But this certainly has been a challenging year as a head coach,” Lanning said. “But I really think, when it’s all said and done, this will be the year that I grow the most. … There is zero doubt in my mind that I’m going to become much better because of this season.” The Oregon vs. Northwestern game is scheduled to kick off at 3:30 p.m. ET. item.title: Luka Doncic makes NBA history vs. Warriors
item.description: Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Luka Doncic makes NBA history vs. Warriors appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Los Angeles Lakers dropped their rematch against the Golden State Warriors in the first night of NBA Cup play. But it wasn’t because of Luka Doncic. Doncic finished Friday night’s game inside Chase Center with 37 points, seven rebounds, five assists, two blocked shots, and one steal in 37 minutes of play. Doncic did shoot just 12-of-27 from the field and 6-of-16 from three in the Lakers loss. The Lakers got off to a hot start, leading the Warriors 40-15 early in the second quarter after Luka Doncic recorded 21 points in the opening period. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) In fact, Doncic’s first quarter statline of 21 points, five assists, one steal, and one block is actually the first time in the play-by-play era that a player recorded those numbers in a single quarter of an NBA game. Luka Doncic in the 1st quarter vs. Warriors: 21 points 5 assists 1 steal 1 block 1st player in the play-by-play era to do that in a single quarter, per @Stathead . pic.twitter.com/uLWaFmvkt5 — Tomer Azarly (@TomerAzarly) October 31, 2026 But the Warriors were quick to bounce back, outscoring the Lakers 38-13 to tie the game at 53 apiece heading into halftime. The Warriors didn’t stop there, pouring it on in the second half and winning by 17 points, 112-95. NBA Cup play factors in point differential, so it’ll be interesting to see how the Lakers bounce back from this opening loss of NBA Cup play. The Lakers and Warriors are in Group C, which includes Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs, Domantas Sabonis and the Sacramento Kings, as well as Deni Avdija and the Portland Trail Blazers. The Lakers next game will be against the Toronto Raptors back at home on Sunday night with Kawhi Leonard not expected to play.. Their next NBA Cup game will be on Friday, November 6th against the Portland Trail Blazers with Ja Morant out due to a hamstring strain. item.title: Atiku accuses INEC of shielding officials behind voter register fraud
item.description: By Luminous Jannamike Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar has accused the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) of concealing evidence and shielding officials implicated in irregularities in the voter register, warning that the scandal threatens the credibility of the 2027 general elections. Atiku said INEC’s admission that AI-generated images and other irregularities had entered the register through registration officers exposed a grave failure of leadership and safeguards at the electoral body, raising fresh questions about the integrity of the database on which millions of Nigerians depend to exercise their franchise. In a statement by Phrank Shaibu, Director of Strategic Communication of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) Presidential Campaign Council, Atiku demanded the identification and prosecution of officials involved, full disclosure of evidence and an independent forensic audit of the voter register. He described INEC’s explanation of how the register was compromised as an attempt to evade responsibility. “That is a disgraceful evasion, not an answer. Even ordinary WhatsApp, Facebook and email accounts appear to have stronger security safeguards than those INEC’s ICT director described on national television. How can the database holding the votes of millions of Nigerians be less secure than a personal social media account?” he asked. Atiku said the Commission must disclose how the register was compromised, identify every officer involved and explain why those implicated had not been suspended or prosecuted. “Amupitan cannot admit the misconduct, withhold the perpetrators’ identities and expect Nigerians to accept ignorance as an excuse. He must account for this failure now,” he said. The former vice president also demanded an independent forensic audit, citing allegations that more than 20 million AI-generated images may have been involved. He warned against any attempt by INEC to quietly remove disputed records without preserving evidence of how the irregularities occurred. “Preserve every voter record, image file, access log and audit trail. Let accredited independent experts, political parties, civil society and credible international observers examine the evidence. No disputed record should be certified until the audit is complete,” he said. Atiku further accused INEC of ignoring opposition parties’ demand for disclosure of companies contracted to produce sensitive election materials, insisting that secrecy over the contractors and their operating protocols was incompatible with a credible election. He demanded that the Commission publish the contractors’ identities and explain the safeguards governing their work, arguing that opposition parties deserved the same information available to the APC-led Federal Government. item.title: Barcelona not ruling out full-back signing in January as Tottenham defender tops shortlist
item.description: Barcelona not ruling out full-back signing in January as Tottenham defender tops shortlist Barcelona could explore the possibility of signing a new full-back during the January transfer window, with Tottenham Hotspur’s Pedro Porro emerging as the preferred target alongside the club’s search for a centre-back. According to Mundo Deportivo journalist Roger Torello, the Catalan club has not ruled out strengthening both defensive positions if suitable opportunities become available. For now, it is known that a centre-back remains the priority for Hansi Flick, whose defensive options have been affected by injuries to Eric Garcia, Andreas Christensen and Jules Kounde. However, Barcelona’s transfer plans could extend further, with a full-back signing also on the agenda, especially after consecutive defeats against Paris Saint-Germain and Real Madrid. Barcelona open to signing another defender As per the outlet, Barcelona’s initial defensive recruitment plans for the previous summer included bringing in both a centre-back and another full-back in addition to Joao Cancelo. However, the club was unable to complete their entire plan because the anticipated departures did not materialise, leaving Flick to work with the defensive options available at his disposal. Barcelona can also look for a full-back signing in January. (Photo by Fran Santiago/Getty Images) The situation has become more pressing following the recent injuries. Eric Garcia sustained a thigh injury , Christensen has been dealing with a physical problem, while Kounde suffered an ankle sprain. Barcelona’s official medical announcement confirmed Garcia’s expected absence of three to four weeks, and Kounde’s return is still in the works. With Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin the only available centre-back options in the squad, Flick has had limited flexibility when selecting his defensive line. Pedro Porro emerges as Barcelona’s preferred full-back target On that note, the standout name in Barcelona’s thinking is Pedro Porro . Pedro Porro is on top of Barcelona’s agenda. (Photo by Michael Regan/Getty Images) The Spanish international has established himself at Tottenham, and the 27-year-old right-back is the defender the Catalans would ideally like to recruit. However, securing his services in January would be particularly difficult because Tottenham extended Porro’s contract in June 2026, committing him to the North London club until 2031, with an option for another year. Therefore, the summer transfer window is a more realistic opportunity for Barcelona to explore the possibility of signing him. At the same time, the financial circumstances are central to that assessment, as Barcelona would first need to generate resources through player departures, allowing the sporting department to pursue a deal without placing additional pressure on the club’s transfer budget. item.title: Real Madrid face complete La Liga broadcast blackout in China as Mbappe controversy deepens
item.description: Real Madrid face complete La Liga broadcast blackout in China as Mbappe controversy deepens Real Madrid’s excellent performances on the pitch in recent weeks have been overshadowed by the growing controversy involving Kylian Mbappe and China. What began as a comment made in jest by the French forward has now escalated into a serious commercial problem. According to Mundo Deportivo , both major broadcasters holding La Liga rights in China have imposed restrictions in the aftermath of the controversy. However, while Barcelona and other Spanish clubs will retain some television coverage, Real Madrid matches are set to face a complete blackout. Real Madrid face tougher restrictions than La Liga rivals China Media Group, which operates state broadcaster CCTV, has temporarily suspended coverage of the entire league. The broadcaster also rejected the initial apologies from both Mbappe and Real Madrid, deeming them insufficient given the content. “We will listen to their words, but we will watch their actions much more closely,” an unnamed representative explained. Kylian Mbappe finds himself embroiled in the controversy with China. (Photo by Mateo Villalba Sanchez/Getty Images) Meanwhile, Migu, the China Mobile subsidiary holding La Liga broadcasting rights until 2030, has adopted a different approach. The platform intends to continue broadcasting the whole competition, except for matches involving Real Madrid. As a result, Barcelona and the remaining La Liga clubs will retain coverage in China through Migu. Mbappe controversy creates serious commercial concerns The dispute began after Mbappe referred to a meme comparing him to former Chinese leader Mao Zedong, describing the figure as a dictator. Despite subsequently apologising, the Madrid forward has already lost three Chinese sponsorship agreements. La Liga president Javier Tebas also intervened, meeting China’s ambassador to Spain in an attempt to resolve the situation. Javier Tebas tried to resolve the conflict between La Liga and China. (Photo by Arnold Jerocki/Getty Images For Sportel) For Real Madrid, the implications extend beyond Mbappe’s personal endorsements. The club holds a percentage of the player’s image rights, meaning they are also affected financially. Although the precise financial damage remains unclear, prolonged restrictions could weaken Madrid’s commercial presence in China. The club has already expressed its respect for Chinese supporters, but the situation has continued to escalate with no end in sight. Real Madrid will hope to find a resolution to this situation sooner rather than later and restore their diplomatic and commercial relationships with China.

item.title: How Heat’s Klay Thompson knew he was ‘due’ for explosive game vs. Pacers
item.description: Isabella Frias-Imagn Images How Heat’s Klay Thompson knew he was ‘due’ for explosive game vs. Pacers appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . MIAMI – With the Miami Heat beating the Indiana Pacers, 145-125, on Saturday night, the team marked its second straight win and showed pieces like Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo continuing to build chemistry. Another positive sign from the win featured Heat newcomer Klay Thompson bouncing back in a huge way after a slow start , but if you ask him, an outing like this was inevitable. After a preseason where Thompson made three out of 20 attempts from three-point range, he had a clean slate at the start of the regular season. However, in the first five games, Thompson averaged 7.8 points per game on 31.7 percent shooting and made 12 of 37 attempts from beyond the arc, for 32.4 percent from deep. While Thompson was still getting his legs underneath him in Miami, Friday night showcased the player that fans have recognized from his days with the Golden State Warriors, where he was pivotal to winning four championships. He finished with 25 points on nine of 14 shooting from the field and making seven three-pointers out of 12 attempts, as he said after the game that he was “due” for a game like he had Friday. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “I really enjoyed it. You can probably tell by my emotion, and for me, it wasn’t the best start to the season. But to come out here and play with poise and confidence, I knew I was due for a night like this,” Thompson said. Klay Thompson on feeling great after his best game of the season and how he’s “really comfortable.” #Heat pic.twitter.com/kRuXVqAgWb — Zachary Weinberger (@ZachWeinberger) October 31, 2026 Heat’s Giannis Antetokounmpo, Erik Spoelstra on Klay Thompson’s role If there was one aspect that helped the Heat win against the Pacers, it was how effective the team was in their flow and in transition, which especially benefitted Thompson. The same sentiments were echoed by head coach Erik Spoelstra, saying to ClutchPoints that Thompson “has an exponential possibility factor for this team.” “We want to maximize those opportunities off misses and push the pace, and we were able to do that. Klay [Thompson] was a beneficiary of a lot of those,” Spoelstra said. “He has an exponential possibility factor for this team, and you can see why because he always will provide the gravity, but he is the definition of ignitable, and when he gets on a roll like that, he is really tough to stop. item.title: “Luke Fahey is Going to End Lincoln Riley’s Job”: CFB Fans React as OSU Names Starting QB After Julian Sayin Injury
item.description: Julian Sayin. © Imagn Ohio State has named the replacement for injured starting quarterback Julian Sayin ahead of this week’s showdown with the USC Trojans. Backup quarterback Luke Fahey earned the nod to start against USC over sophomore Tavien St. Clair. Fahey, a true freshman, replaced Sayin against Indiana after earning the backup role during preseason camp. He has completed 9 of 13 passes for 203 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions this season. Meanwhile, St. Clair, a former five-star recruit, has completed 5 of 7 passes for 52 yards, one touchdown, and one interception. Fans reacted to the latest update from the Buckeyes. “Luke is going to end Lincoln Riley’s job,” one fan predicted about the Trojans’ head coach. “C’mon young buck take us to the promise land,” one fan commented. “How tall is this kid really anyway?” one fan asked. “Shocking lol,” one fan reacted. “Ohio State might not make the playoffs with this kid at QB, and I thought there was a 5-star QB behind Sayin already,” one fan wrote. “Rolling out a 5’10” 210 lbs freshman QB certainly is a choice. I can’t see how this could end poorly at all,” one fan added. What Happened to OSU QB Julian Sayin? Julian Sayin injured his throwing arm during Ohio State’s 19-15 victory over Indiana a couple of weeks ago. He left the game after Indiana defensive lineman Mario Landino sacked him with about eight minutes remaining in the fourth quarter. After visiting the locker room, Sayin was spotted on the sideline wearing a sling on his right arm. Before leaving with the injury, Sayin completed 15-of-29 passes for 235 yards and two touchdowns, with two interceptions, against the Hoosiers. Three days later, on Oct. 20, Ohio State head coach Ryan Day said Sayin was out indefinitely, adding that the Buckeyes are preparing as if the signal-caller could miss the rest of the season. Before his injury entering Week 7, Sayin threw for 1,772 yards and 17 touchdowns with just two interceptions. “We’re not going to put any timeline on his recovery, but he is out indefinitely,” Day said. “Based on the nature of the injury, we are putting a plan in place for him not being available for the regular season, and then also, him not being available for the postseason.” Ahead of the No. 2 Buckeyes’ trip to Los Angeles to face USC on Saturday, Ohio State initially gave both backup quarterbacks Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair first-team reps . Finally, with one day to go, they chose Fahey for an important Big Ten showdown on the road. item.title: Why Colton Herta Is One Superlicence Point Short Despite Appearing to Reach 40
item.description: Colton Herta is still a point away from being eligible for the superlicense. (Source: MEGA) Cadillac prodigy Colton Herta ‘s superlicence situation has caused a massive stir in the world of F1, with confusion being the theme around his eligibility. While early calculations had him sitting comfortably at 40 points, which is enough points to qualify for the license, the current tally only adds up to 39 points. Having verified its calculations with the FIA in July, Cadillac opted to run Herta in the Mexico City GP FP1 for 100 kilometers to ensure he got the remaining point on his license. But it turned out that the American driver was in fact two points away from the 40-point mark. An issue with the official website of IndyCar had Colton Herta listed in P6 in the 2025 championship instead of P7. (Source: MEGA) The confusion stems from a technical error on IndyCar’s official website. When looking at the final driver rankings of the 2025 season, Herta finished level on points with Felix Rosenqvist. The result meant both drivers were listed on P6 in the rankings, handing Herta six points on his superlicence. However, Rosenqvist had more second-place finishes in the season, meaning Herta would officially be listed in seventh. This meant that instead of six, the Cadillac reserve driver only accumulated four points on his superlicence according to the old points distribution system. And with 100 kilometers under his belt at the Mexico City GP FP1, Herta now has 39 points, instead of the 40 he thought he had. What Next for Colton Herta and Cadillac? Now that the calculations have been sorted, Herta’s official tally stands at 39 points, four of which have come from four FP1 outings in F1. Placing seventh in IndyCar in 2025 fetched him another four points, while a runner-up finish in 2024 saw Herta bank 30 points. In 2023, a 10th-place finish in IndyCar earned the American his first point of the superlicence, meaning there’s still time left for him to be eligible for a full-time seat in F1. | CORRECTION: Colton Herta is still one point away from a Superlicense. An error on the IndyCar website showed Herta as having finished P6 in the 2025 standings – but he actually finished P7. So he still needs one more Superlicense point. — formularacers (@formularacers_) October 30, 2026 Given the tally, Herta needs one more point on his superlicence, and he can earn that by running another 100 kilometers in any of the remaining FP1s in 2026. What’s important here is that Herta and Cadillac have to make sure that he does so this year itself, or else he will have to start from zero next year. After 2027, the IndyCar points on Herta’s license will expire, but should he apply for a superlicence before that, it wouldn’t matter much. Even if the American driver does not become a part of the F1 grid next season, he wouldn’t have to worry about his 2028 chances, given he will fall into the ‘previous license holders’ category. item.title: 'He has no confidence' - Micah Richards warns Mikel Arteta he must sell Arsenal flop if poor run of form continues
item.description: FBL-ENG-PR-BRIGHTON-ARSENAL - AFP Arsenal have been told they may need to cut their losses on Viktor Gyokeres if the Swedish international cannot find a way to turn his faltering form around. Despite a respectable goal return during his maiden campaign at the Emirates, the forward has struggled for minutes and impact during the current season. Struggling to find his feet Gyokeres enjoyed a productive debut season in north London, netting 22 times across all competitions. However, the 28-year-old has rapidly tumbled down Mikel Arteta's pecking order this term, managing just one start in the club's opening eight Premier League fixtures. While the striker finally opened his account for the campaign during a midweek clash with Fleetwood Town, doubts over his long-term future persist. His overall lack of sharpness has led to heavy criticism from prominent pundits, who feel he is failing to justify a place in Arteta's squad. Richards questions Gyokeres' confidence imago-sport-1085143974.jpg Speaking on The Rest Is Football podcast, Richards highlighted the Swedish international's visible struggles and pointed out a sharp decline in his core strengths. "I think one of the major talking points as well is Gyokeres," Richards said. "When he first arrived at Arsenal, I was saying to the Arsenal fans, 'Don’t expect him to be scoring 25 and 30 goals'. What I really liked about him, he was good at running in behind, but he stopped doing the things that he’s really good at." The former defender suggested the forward looks entirely devoid of belief on the pitch. "He sort of looks like he has no confidence," Richards continued. "I don’t know if the reports in the summer that they tried to get rid of him [were true] or not, but essentially he’s had enough game time to show what he can do now at Arsenal and it’s just not happening for him. "There are so many times where Gyokeres gets in really good positions, and I don’t know if he doesn’t back himself, I don’t know if it’s confidence, I don’t know if the team doesn’t back him to score, but he just, he doesn’t put the ball away. So, then it becomes a problem." Arsenal urged to enter the transfer market If Gyokeres cannot find a breakthrough soon, Richards believes the Gunners must ruthlessly cut ties. "I just feel like he needs one of those opportunities where he plays 90 minutes, he scores, he builds confidence, and it goes from there," he explained. "Otherwise, you know, they’re going to have to look to move him on." He added: "I think in January, because of the injuries, I definitely think they should go back into the market, and find top cover around. Because the way Arsenal play, and everyone talks about they need this player, they need that player, but the reason why they’re so good is what the front players do off the ball… so, [Bukayo] Saka and [Noni] Madueke work hard in a system that works for Arsenal. item.title: Senegal kicks off Youth Games, Africa’s first ever Olympics
item.description: The 2026 Youth Olympic Games, the first Olympics ever to be held on African soil, open Saturday in the Senegalese capital marking an historic moment for the continent. Signs proclaiming “Africa welcomes, Dakar celebrates” are abundant across Dakar, which is hosting some 2,665 young competitors aged 14 to 17 from around the world. The event marks the return of Russian athletes to the Olympics and also includes a refugee team. Overall, the athletes will compete across 25 sports and 153 medal events. “We’ve got people from around the world that maybe had a very different idea about Africa and they’re going to leave, hopefully, with something really positive in mind”, International Olympic Committee (IOC) President Kirsty Coventry, a former Zimbabwean swimmer, said Thursday during a press conference in Dakar. “I think that is really important for our continent”, she said. Events ranging from athletics to beach wrestling, rugby sevens to breaking, will be held across eight venues in three locations. Dakar, the nearby suburb of Diamniadio and the beach town of Saly located some 80 kilometres (50 miles) from the capital, will all host events. – Sports culture – An opening ceremony Saturday evening in Diamniadio will kick off the Games. A total of 136 Senegalese athletes will participate in the Youth Olympics, with some 6,000 volunteers from Senegal helping put on the event. The west African nation is renowned for its sports culture, including its football team, traditional wrestling and surf scene. Football enthusiasts and young people often organise impromptu matches in the evenings or weekends on the beach or in village squares. And as the day cools, hundreds of people flock to Dakar’s iconic coastal road, the Corniche, to run, do strength training or take part in group exercise. While a sense of excitement is beginning to stir in the capital, the fourth summer edition of the Youth Olympics have struggled to stoke wild enthusiasm across Senegal. Many are more concerned with the high cost of living, unemployment and economic hardship. “Once the youth Olympic Games in Senegal begin, Dakar will become the capital of African youth,” Senegal Prime Minister Ahmadou Al Aminou Lo said in an interview with AFP this week. “Africa hosting the (Youth) Olympic Games, it’s a symbol”, he said. – Russian athletes – With the IOC effectively lifting the Russian Olympic Committee’s (ROC) suspension in July, the Youth Games will mark the first Olympic competition since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in early 2022 in which Russian athletes are allowed to compete under their own flag and colours. According to the ROC, 13 Russian athletes will participate and 10 coaches will accompany them to Senegal. “The kids are excited, it’s good news that our legitimate right to participate with the national anthem and Russian flag has been restored”, Anzor Gaunov, who coaches Anastasia Dobrovolskaya in judo, told AFP earlier this month in Moscow. item.title: Jemimah Rodrigues returns after hamstring injury, joins Mumbai squad in Pune
item.description: MUMBAI: India women's team batter Jemimah Rodrigues has recovered from a hamstring injury that had kept her out of action for three months and has joined the Mumbai team in Pune for the ongoing Senior Women's T20 Elite domestic tournament. She will now turn out for Mumbai in their remaining matches in the tournament. The development means that Rodrigues is set to return to action for the Indian women's team during their multi-format tour of South Africa in December. “Life Update: HAMSTRING HAS BEEN DECLARED FIT!!!!!!!! After 3 months of rehab. Now I can’t wait to get going,” Jemimah wrote on her Instagram account on Friday. The 26-year-old tore her right hamstring while playing for Southern Brave against Welsh Fire in The Hundred in England earlier this year. Scans at the BCCI Centre of Excellence later confirmed a high-grade tear, which meant that Jemimah was ruled out of the Women's T20 Asia Cup in the UAE, the Asian Games in Japan and India's recently concluded white-ball series against Zimbabwe at home. Ironically, Jemimah's return to fitness comes on the first anniversary of her scoring an unbeaten 127 against Australia in the ODI World Cup semifinal at the DY Patil Stadium in Navi Mumbai. Riding on that innings, India went on to win the trophy. The Indian women's team's tour of South Africa will include a one-off Test, three ODIs and three T20Is.

item.title: INTERVIEW: Bayern chief Rouven Kasper feels Der Klassiker is "as strong as El Classico"
item.description: INTERVIEW: Bayern chief Rouven Kasper feels Der Klassiker is "as strong as El Classico" MÜNCHEN ( Bulinews ) Ahead of their meeting with Borussia Dortmund, Bayern Munich's director of sales and marketing, Rouven Kasper, was eager to explain just how important Der Klassiker is for both clubs. "For us [at Bayern Munich] it's not just Bayern versus Dortmund," said Kasper, emphasizing just how critical Saturday's game is during a media round which was attended by Bulinews.com amongst others. "We're really trying to build a brand around Der Klassiker. You have had El Classico [FC Barcelona vs. Real Madrid in La Liga], which everyone knows for decades, and we are as strong as the El Classico. "It's the biggest game of the season and we play it twice a season. But also you see it's not just big in Germany [that it's a popular game] but also internationally too. "The viewership is double the amount of a standard Bundesliga Topspiel game [on Saturday evening]. So there is really big focus on this match because the two strongest teams are playing against eachother," he said. Perhaps the most marketable thing both clubs have to offer when playing each other is the football itself. Kasper is quick to point out the attacking nature of Bayern and BVB, and also why this is the perfect recipe for attracting followers. "This, you also feel comes into the international viewership. The match will be broadcast in over 200 countries which is important for us, because they see this very active [style of] football. “The Bundesliga is known for [this style] and we focus on this as the Bundesliga. We are advertising this heavily with campaigns for Der Klassiker all around the world. We are doing this to broadcasting partners as well,” he added.

item.title: “We’ll Never Be Washed Bruh”: LeBron James Fans Amped After Sixers Star Scores Dagger in First 20-Point Game of the Season in Win vs. Knicks
item.description: LeBron James dominated 76ers win over Knicks © X/ @sixers LeBron James’ uneven start to his Philadelphia 76ers career in year 24 left fans wondering whether Father Time had finally caught up. His numbers tanked across the board, and he hadn’t had a game where fans were confident he could do what they’d been accustomed to seeing for nearly two and a half decades. James averaged 15.5 points, 6.5 rebounds, and 6.8 assists. He shot 42.6% from the field, 23.1% from the 3-point line, and 61.9% from the free-throw line in his first four games. His points-per-game production and 3-point and free-throw shooting splits are his career-worst marks. James’ field goal shooting clip is his worst since his rookie year. The belief about James losing his edge only grew after Jalen Slawson blocked him on a chase-down and Andrew Nembhard snapped his ankles the same night the Sixers beat the Pacers 114-109 on Wednesday. However, James turned back the clock on Friday against the New York Knicks and produced his best performance of the year in a 98-93 win. The four-time MVP scored 20 points, grabbed nine rebounds and dished eight assists. James shot 8-for-15 and hit the dagger with 12 seconds left to put the Sixers up five. James also hit a tough fadeaway jumper to give Philly a one-point lead with 1:10 left. LeBron James’ fans didn’t miss the chance to clap back at critics who believed the Sixers star might be done. “Did this after all the washed edits and memes. Plus he hit a clutch shot in the 4th. We’ll never be washed bruh,” one fan said. Even Skip Bayless lauds LeBron James’ fit with the Sixers Skip Bayless has been a renowned LeBron James critic. However, even the veteran sports analyst couldn’t help but praise James’ fit and performance against the Knicks. “Sixers continue to show they’re just better than the champs. Held Knicks to 93. No JB, but LeBron had a strong game: 20/9/8, nice lane fadeaway w 1:10 left and late follow. He’s fitting in not out,” Bayless wrote on X. The Sixers improved to 2-0 against the defending NBA champions after also taking care of business at MSG in the season opener. On Friday, the Sixers did it without 2024 NBA Finals MVP Jaylen Brown. That opened up more opportunities for LeBron James to play more aggressively as a scorer, and the 41-year-old delivered. James had 12 points, five rebounds, and five assists by halftime. He made a couple of baskets early, which put him in a nice rhythm the rest of the game. Tyrese Maxey also shone with 27 points on 52.6% shooting, while Anfernee Simons scored 21 off the bench, going 5-for-8 from deep. item.title: Lennart Karl: Man United keeping tabs on Bayern Munich’s record-breaking 18-year-old
item.description: Lennart Karl: Man United keeping tabs on Bayern Munich’s record-breaking 18-year-old Manchester United are always on the lookout for young talent. Search for young talent They have scoured the market in England, Europe, and further afield to bring in players with promising skills. This is evident in their acquisitions of Isaac Konde from Liverpool, as well as David Eze and Karim Cassim from Manchester City. They have also signed Cristian Orozco from Colombia and Diego Leon from Paraguay in the last 18 months or so. Latest interest According to German football expert Christian Falk , United are also showing an interest in a young talent from the Bundesliga. Uli Hoeneß, a former German football executive at Bayern Munich who is currently in a supervisory role on the board, spoke out against Lennart Karl recently. He stated that Karl needed to learn humility, but this is reportedly not an opinion shared by the majority of the board, who want to keep the midfielder. Falk’s information states that “those who are involved in the daily business are very confident in Karl. They want to keep him.” Nonetheless, Premier League clubs are aware of the potential unrest and “the Premier League is also reading what is being said in Germany.” Falk claimed that he has heard that “Arsenal, Liverpool and Manchester United saw that there is something going on around Lennart Karl. Ultimately, when there’s a player at the Ballon d ‘Or ceremony who finished fourth in the Men’s Kopa Trophy (behind Warren Zaire-Emery, Pau Cubarsi and Lamine Yamal), he’s going to be interesting to other clubs.” The journalist claims calls have been made and Karl has a value of €60m [£50.1m], “so it’s more than possible” for Premier League clubs to get involved and that the situation is “getting interesting”. Falk also confirmed that there has so far been no contact over a new deal. Who is Lennart Karl? Karl is an attacking midfielder or winger who has scored 10 goals in 51 appearances for Bayern and is seen as one of Europe’s most talented youngsters. He has also been described as “a dynamic, low-centre-of-gravity dribbler and playmaker who typically operates as a central number 10 or cuts inside from the right wing onto his stronger left foot.” The youngster is also Bayern’s youngest ever Champions League goalscorer, whose “meteoric emergence for both club and country has captivated spectators across Europe, earning him acclaim from top figures across the game.” The Peoples Person Reliability Assessment Overall credibility: 8/10 Why? ✅ Lennart Karl is almost certainly a player that Man United, like all top clubs, will be watching. ✅ The news is no more concrete than United keeping tabs on the situation, so is very likely to be the case ⚠️ Christian Falk can be hit or miss for German transfer stories TPP view We believe that United would almost certainly be keeping tabs on a player like Lennart Karl due to his age and his rise in European football. item.title: Liverpool's £87m nightmare: Star left without place at Anfield
item.description: Liverpool's £87m nightmare: Star left without place at Anfield One Liverpool star doesn't have a clear place at Anfield right now. That's despite the club spending a fortune to get his future sorted. Liverpool spent a lot of money under Richard Hughes. An awful lot. Record amounts. It was unlike anything we’ve ever seen from the Reds and no one can currently say if it was actually a good idea. The squad undoubtedly has some brilliant players it in right now but is the squad actually good as a whole? No one is able to say for certain that’s perhaps the worst indictment of Hughes’s time in charge as sporting director. Yes, he went and spent loads but was it even worth it? And that money spent wasn’t just on incoming players. He also renewed some contracts for massive money and in ways that we’re no longer sure were correct. The Ryan Gravenberch contract Liverpool spent around £87m on Ryan Gravenberch this year. That's the reported amount put into his new long-term contract, one that keeps him around for the foreseeable future. We called it a nightmare back in April , around a month after it was signed. Why? Because it was quickly apparent that Liverpool had no idea how to use Gravenberch, despite committing all that money to him. His best form as a sitting midfielder in the title-winning campaign but once teams had sussed out Liverpool's way of playing, he was no long adequate in the role. It's why we were comparing him to Curtis Jones in that article - the Scouser was doing that holding role far better, with much more involvement and a lot more consistency. Andoni Iraola has recognised that. Gravenberch started the first game of the season in the role but was moved away from there and hasn't really been back since. Alexis Mac Allister and Trey Nyoni have instead played it, with the Dutchman operating further forward. However, Gravenberch doesn't have an obvious other role. He's not very solid in the no.8 position, rarely getting the ball and operating as a bit of a purgatory on the pitch. He played there against Chelsea on Wednesday, for instance, and while that should have been a possession-heavy role with lots of involvement, he only completed 22 passes. Trey Nyoni, playing slightly deeper, completed 65 in 10 fewer minutes for comparison. His desire to burst forward doesn't work without a defensive midfielder, either. This was clear against Manchester City even when he was getting plaudits. It was enormously clear against Newcastle United in the first game of the season, where Gravenberch was caught too far forward on both goals. The player also struggles to operate with Florian Wirtz, frequently getting into the same space that Wirtz wants to play in but offering far less. But if you play him instead of the German, you get an incredible drop of quality from the entire team because Gravenberch cannot play the no.10 role. So where does he play? item.title: MotoGP Malaysian GP: Pedro Acosta beats Marc Marquez in tense sprint
item.description: Motorsport photo Pedro Acosta claimed his second career sprint victory with a win for KTM in an edgy Saturday race at Sepang. World championship leader Marc Marquez extended his advantage over the absent Jorge Martin to 19 points by taking second place. It was an intriguing contest, with ever-present rain drops threatening to gain in severity at any time. Several riders further down the pack did in fact gamble on changing bikes in the hopes that the rain might intensify - but the serious downpour only came when the riders were celebrating afterwards. That it was Acosta with the gold medal around his neck had much to do with polesitter Alex Marquez crashing out of the lead on the third tour of the Sepang circuit. Having grabbed the initiative at the first corner, the Gresini Ducati rider had looked in control of proceedings until that point. Alex's departure left Ai Ogura at the head of the field, but with only a narrow advantage over Acosta, Marc Marquez and Marco Bezzecchi. Ogura had earlier worked his way ahead of the first two in an aggressive run through the opening two corners of the race. The Dutch Grand Prix winner was only able to hold the lead until lap eight, however. That's when Acosta made his move. Stubborn defence by Ogura ultimately also allowed Marquez to take second, with Bezzecchi demoting the Japanese rider to fourth a lap later. Acosta hung on for the win ahead of his 2027 factory Ducati team-mate, who could be satisfied with nine points after injured title rival Jorge Martin withdrew from proceeedings earlier in the day. Acosta now has a brace of sprint wins to his name, with the other also coming in Asia, at the season opener in Thailand. He broke his Sunday race duck when he won the Austrian Grand Prix a few weeks ago. For much of the race, fifth place was an all-Italian battle between Francesco Bagnaia, Fabio Di Giannantonio and Enea Bastianini. But late in proceedings, Di Giannantonio made it past Bagnaia and Bastianini dropped back to ninth spot. That left Brad Binder and Diogo Moreira, who racily progressed eight and six spots from their grid positions respectively, to take seventh and eighth. item.title: ‘I’m just having fun’- Stephen Curry reacts to viral Luka Doncic ankle-breaker
item.description: Photo by Ezra Shaw/Getty Images Stephen Curry has reacted after sending Luka Doncic to the floor with a stunning crossover before knocking down a three-pointer during the Golden State Warriors’ 112-95 comeback win over the Los Angeles Lakers. The Warriors star produced one of the standout moments of their NBA Cup opener, leaving Doncic struggling to stay on his feet midway through the third quarter. Curry, who finished with 31 points, six assists and four rebounds, admitted he did not expect the move to look quite so spectacular. Stephen Curry explains his reaction after embarrassing Luka Doncic Speaking after the game, Curry explained that he was simply looking to create some room before the crossover caught everyone by surprise. “I was just trying to get a little bit of space. I didn’t expect it to get that n****,” Curry said. “But it was one of those [where] you gotta kind of keep your composure.” The 38-year-old appeared just as surprised as everyone watching, putting both hands on his head after sinking the three-pointer before running back on defence. Curry also referenced James Harden’s famous celebration, admitting he had not found himself with that much space to shoot in quite some time. “I remember James Harden had to do like the shimmy to get himself going back in the day,” he added. “I don’t know, I haven’t been that open in a long time.” However, the highlight was only one part of a remarkable night for Golden State, who recovered from a 25-point deficit to claim a 17-point victory. Doncic had given the Lakers a commanding start, scoring 21 points in the opening quarter as Los Angeles raced into a 38-15 lead. The Warriors responded with an identical second-quarter score to level the game by half-time before taking control after the break. Curry’s performance also saw him move past Dominique Wilkins into 18th place on the NBA’s all-time scoring list. Despite the viral moment, the Warriors veteran made it clear that his enjoyment of basketball remains the biggest priority as his career progresses. “I just love this game,” Curry said. “All my mannerisms are just all over the place because I’m just having fun.” “Those moments, especially at this stage of your career, you’re just appreciative of the ability to keep playing at this level. And I want that joy to continue until I’m done.” Golden State have now recorded three consecutive wins after opening the season with three straight defeats, giving Curry and his team fresh momentum as their NBA Cup campaign continues. item.title: US judge issues restraining order against Justice Dept over election directives
item.description: A US federal judge temporarily blocked on Friday the Justice Department from threatening state and local election officials with criminal prosecution if they fail to comply with its directives on processing ballots. The order by Judge Trina Thompson in the Northern District of California deals a setback to Trump administration efforts to restrict voting by people it says might not be US citizens in the November 3 midterm elections. The harshly worded temporary restraining order was issued in response to a case brought by labor union and civil rights groups against the Justice Department and Department of Homeland Security. “Defendants shall not threaten, intimidate or coerce state or local elections officials or workers to demand that they halt processing the ballots of any registered voter solely on the basis that the ballot belongs to an individual alleged by Defendants to be ineligible to vote,” Thompson wrote. The judge also ruled that Justice Department officials “shall not threaten state or local election officials and workers with criminal prosecution for failure to comply” with such demands. President Donald Trump’s Republican Party is at risk of losing its control of Congress in next Tuesday’s elections, and critics have accused his administration of trying to cast doubt on electoral results. On Wednesday, a federal judge rejected the Justice Department’s efforts to set aside the ballots of more than 20,000 California voters it said might not be citizens, slamming the move as brazen pre-election “interference.” In Friday’s ruling, Thompson said that a restraining order, which expires on November 16, was justified “given the fast-approaching date of the Election” and because the plaintiffs “have demonstrated that they will likely succeed on the merits of their claims.” Thompson described the “intimidation” and threats of criminal prosecution of election workers as “contrary to law” and “arbitrary and capricious.” In a wide-ranging order, the judge said the defendants shall not demand the removal of specific registered voters from voter lists, nor refuse to issue ballots to specific voters nor demand ballots not be counted because of alleged ineligibility to vote. For months, Trump — who has never acknowledged his own election defeat by Joe Biden in 2020 — has been claiming that there will be fraud in this year’s midterms. Studies repeatedly show that while rare cases of voter fraud exist, such incidents are minuscule and do not influence US election results. AFP The post US judge issues restraining order against Justice Dept over election directives appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: ‘Steph Curry Is a Bad Man,’ ‘Cleans the Floor With Luka (Dončić)’ — NBA World Loses It After Warriors Star Breaks Lakers Rival’s Ankles, Drains 3
item.description: Stephen Curry sends Luka Dončić to the floor before drilling a step-back 3, sparking reactions during Golden State’s win. Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry gave fans plenty to talk about Friday night during an NBA Cup matchup against the Los Angeles Lakers. His one-on-one encounter with Luka Dončić produced one of the game’s most memorable moments. The play came as Golden State fought back from a 25-point deficit at Chase Center, with both stars trading baskets in the third quarter. NBA Community Erupts as Stephen Curry Drops Luka Dončić With Nasty Highlight Dončić scored 21 points in the first quarter as the Lakers raced to a 38-15 lead. Golden State responded with a 38-15 second quarter, setting up a close contest after halftime. With 6:22 left in the third, Curry isolated Dončić and worked him with a string of dribble moves until the former Dallas Mavericks star lost his footing and fell to the floor. The two-time MVP stepped back and buried a 24-foot 3-pointer, cutting the deficit to 69-63. Hoop Central posted the clip: “Steph Curry drops Luka Doncic. Oh my goodness.” One fan reacted , writing: “Curry cleans the floor with Luka.” Hoop Central added : “Steph Curry is a bad man. This is crazy.” The Warriors guard later admitted he hadn’t expected Dončić to go down. “I was just trying to get a little bit of space. I didn’t expect it to get that nasty… I haven’t been that open in a long time.” Legion Hoops also shared the highlight: “Steph Curry made Luka touch the earth. Oh my.” Another fan remarked , “Broke his ankles for life.” A third reaction was brief: “Oh my God.” Another fan offered a much broader assessment of Curry: “Nobody has ever been better than Wardell.” The crossover was part of a strong shooting night for Curry, who finished with 31 points and made 8 of his 14 attempts from beyond the arc. He had scored 44 points against the Minnesota Timberwolves two nights earlier. SEE ALSO: ‘Best Draymond (Green) Impression,’ ‘Bogus Call’ – Hoops Fans Debate Dillon Brooks’ Ejection After Groin Shot on Jamal Murray Dončić answered the move with a 27-foot step-back 3-pointer on the next possession. The Lakers star finished with a game-high 37 points, but Los Angeles scored just 15 points in the fourth quarter. Curry has now passed Dominique Wilkins for 18th on the NBA’s all-time scoring list with 26,674 points in all. Next up is Oscar Robertson’s tally of 26,710, and DeMar DeRozan’s 26,763. Golden State won 112-95, setting the largest margin of victory in the shot-clock era by a team that trailed by at least 20 points at the end of the first quarter. The previous mark was a 14-point Warriors victory over the Chicago Bulls in 1976. This article originally appeared on Pro Football Network .

item.title: Chelsea fans’ preferred lineup against Manchester United: Formation change!
item.description: LONDON, ENGLAND - AUGUST 15: Cole Palmer, Josh Acheampong, Morgan Rogers, Levi Colwill and Mike Penders of Chelsea acknowledge the fans after the pre-season friendly match between Chelsea and Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge on August 15, 2026 in London, England. (Photo by Chris Lee - Chelsea FC/Chelsea FC via Getty Images) | Chelsea FC via Getty Images So far this season, Chelsea have used a back-three setup almost exclusively, even at the cost of playing players out of position — or having them learn and transition to new roles, like in the case of Pedro Neto doing a Victor Moses. But after the debacle of the Spurs game — and thanks to a few injuries — we saw a back-four midweek against Liverpool in the League Cup. We also saw a three-man midfield in that game, after the pairing of Moisés Caicedo and Jordan Henderson got overrun by Spurs. What will Xabi Alonso choose today? We’ll find out soon enough. For the WAGNH Community, the answer is pretty clearly a back-four: 4-2-3-1 and 4-3-3 formations combined for over a two-thirds majority (66%) with the usual 3-4-3/3-4-2-1 collecting just 30 per cent of the vote. In terms of personnel, there are also a few notable changes. At the back, we have a start for Marco Palestra, which is surely overdue, while Wesley Fofana (32%) comes nowhere near one. In midfield, it’s Henderson who just beats out Roméo Lavia (52%) to partner Caicedo. In attack, we get no recognized striker but Pedro Neto and Morgan Rogers have both seen time at the position, with varying degrees of success.
